name: API Routes
description: Lists the backend API endpoints (HTTP method and full path) grouped by route file in backend/app/api/routes. Reads the Python source statically with ast; it does not import or start the app.

actions.title: List API endpoints
actions.description: Parses each route file, combines the APIRouter prefix with each @router.<method>(path) decorator, and publishes one row per endpoint. Paths include the API prefix (default /api/v1, as set in app/core/config.py). Does not run the backend.

api_prefix.description: Prefix put before every path (settings.API_V1_STR). Use an empty string for router-relative paths.

file.description: Show only one route file, for example users.py. Empty shows all.
